title: T13 — Architecture artefact index (rework, 2026-11-22)
body:
# Architecture Artefacts — T13 Tool platform

## Metadata

Seven approved retrospective A–D artefacts (all status approved; authored in the rework record).

## Entries

| Phase | Kind | Artefact | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | catalog | Driver/Goal/Objective Catalogue | approved |
| A | catalog | Requirements Catalogue | approved |
| A | diagram | Solution Concept Diagram | approved |
| A | matrix | Stakeholder Map | approved |
| B | diagram | Business Capability Map | approved |
| C | catalog | Data Entity Catalogue | approved |
| D | catalog | Technology Standards Catalogue | approved |

## Links

Each artefact is a typed `architecture_artifact` row (id in the register); the requirements catalogue
traces the six §12 clauses; the solution concept derives from the inception analysis.

## Document

The published documents: `T13 Tool platform — inception analysis` (inception-analysis) and
`T13 Tool platform — architecture design` (architecture-design); this index is the
architecture-artifact document.
